rationale: S-0052-02 proposes a GABA-synapse-count sweep on t0052 to characterise driving-force saturation of scalar gabaMOD IPSPs (somatic IPSP voltage ratio under-predicts conductance ratio because driving force saturates near E_GABA). The from-scratch family (t0052 - t0059) has been deprioritised: the project pivoted to deposited Bed A and Bed B substrates, and the scalar gabaMOD design itself is being superseded by deposited beds' synaptic protocols. The driving-force saturation finding from t0052 stands as recorded; characterising the saturation curve quantitatively in the from-scratch substrate adds limited value to the deposited-bed critical path. Rejecting as stale.
